## Spotify Advertising

Spotify Advertising is the ads business of Spotify, a digital audio and video platform reaching 761 million fans across music, podcasts, and audiobooks in more than 180 markets. It runs audio, video, display, and carousel formats through Spotify Ads Manager (self-serve) and the Spotify Ad Exchange (programmatic), with targeting built around listener moments like Driving, Exercise, Chill, Gaming, and Party rather than demographics alone.

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Minimum spend | $250 via Spotify Ads Manager self-serve |
| Self-serve | Yes, no agency required |
| Reach | 761M+ fans across 180+ markets |
| Targeting | Listener moments, interests, demographics, location, device, custom and lookalike audiences |
| Ad formats | Audio, video, display, carousel; Sponsored Playlists, Canvas, Now Playing View |

For a small advertiser already testing Tubi or another streaming TV platform, digital audio is a reasonable parallel line to run: a driving-time audio ad reaches a commuter the TV screen will not, and the self-serve path is similar in shape to the CTV tools above. Pair it with a CTV test rather than swap, and track with the same promo code or vanity URL.

*Sponsored: text supplied by Vibe.*

Access to streaming TV is one consideration; the ability to manage and evaluate campaigns is another. Vibe is a self-serve streaming TV advertising platform designed for performance marketers, with campaigns starting at $50 per day.

Its targeting options include first-party CRM audiences, lookalikes, and intent signals. Measurement integrations include Triple Whale, Northbeam, and Haus, giving teams additional ways to assess CTV alongside their existing marketing activity.

For smaller advertisers comparing platforms, Vibe provides another option to evaluate against campaign controls, audience requirements, reporting, and total test budget. Integration capabilities and the suitability of an incrementality test should be confirmed for the intended campaign.

*Sponsored: text supplied by Vibe.*

Managed-service minimums are not the only route into streaming TV. Vibe is a self-serve streaming TV advertising platform that lets advertisers start campaigns at $50 per day without an annual contract.

For a smaller advertiser, that offers a way to explore CTV before committing to a larger programme. Vibe combines audience targeting with campaign reporting and integrations with measurement tools such as Triple Whale and Northbeam, helping performance teams evaluate TV alongside their other advertising channels.

A lower daily entry point does not guarantee a conclusive test. Advertisers still need sufficient reach, frequency, and campaign duration to assess results, with the budget matched to the audience and measurement approach.

*Sponsored: text supplied by Vibe.*

A small CTV test requires a buying platform whose entry requirements fit the proposed budget. Vibe is a self-serve streaming TV advertising platform with campaigns starting at $50 per day, providing an option for advertisers exploring a limited initial commitment.

Campaign controls and reporting help teams evaluate delivery, while integrations with tools such as Triple Whale and Northbeam can support broader performance analysis. Advertisers should establish the campaign duration, target audience, creative approach, and success criteria before launching.

For a local business, the useful distinction is between being able to launch a small test and gathering enough evidence to make a scaling decision. A modest budget can support initial exploration, but the reliability of the results depends on the test design.
